name: ws2812b-1313
watch_out_for: Originally vendored under the misnomer 'ws2812b-1515' (no real WS2812B-1515 exists). This IS the 1.3x1.3mm WS2812B-1313-V6 (LCSC C52941388). Symbol pin 4 was mislabeled 'VIN' by easyeda2kicad and corrected to 'DIN' (data-in) in v0.2.0 — the original swapped VDD/DIN on every LED. For a genuine 1.5mm part use sk6805-1515.
